server.title: Make Niko fit your room.
server.text: Manage the settings that shape how Niko behaves in this server. Economy balances remain global to each user and are not configured here.
server.introText: Command prefixes and log destinations live here.
server.prefixesDetail: Add each command prefix separately. Niko will respond to all configured prefixes.
server.prefixLocked: Prefix changes are disabled for this deployment.
server.prefixFixed: This instance uses the fixed prefix {prefix}.
server.loggingDetail: Pick a channel for each event type and disable categories you do not need.
boosters.title: Give every boost a personal thank-you.
boosters.text: Set up boost announcements and let active boosters create and share their own server role.
boosters.loadError: Booster settings could not be loaded.
boosters.announceDetail: Choose where boost and unboost messages appear, then customize both messages.
boosters.enableAnnouncementsHint: Messages are only posted after a member starts or stops boosting.
boosters.unboostHint: Uses the same placeholders as the boost message.
boosters.rolesDetail: Each active booster gets a separate role they can customize and share.
boosters.enableRolesHint: Active boosters can use /boosterrole to rename, recolor, set an icon, and share or unshare their role.
boosters.rolesNote: Turning this off deletes Niko-managed booster roles and removes them from the boosters and anyone they shared them with. Role icons and gradient colors are available only when Discord unlocks those perks for your server.
boosters.saveFailed: Booster settings could not be saved.
